description: This Java class 'MimeMessageWrapper' provides a serializable wrapper around the javax.mail.internet.MimeMessage object, enabling serialization/deserialization, and offers methods to access email headers, content, parts, and attachments within email messages.

classes.name: MimeMessageWrapper
classes.description: A serializable wrapper for MimeMessage enabling serialization, header/content access, and message parsing.

classes.name: MimeMessageToString
classes.description: A converter class to transform MimeMessageWrapper instances into String representations for email sending.

methods.name: setSession
methods.description: Sets the email session and updates mail properties.

methods.name: getSession
methods.description: Retrieves the current email session, creating one if null.

methods.name: setMessage
methods.description: Serializes and stores a MimeMessage, capturing content type and parts count.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Deserializes and returns the MimeMessage if not already loaded.

methods.name: getFirstHeader
methods.description: Returns the first value of a specified email header.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Retrieves all values of a specified email header.

methods.name: getFrom
methods.description: Returns the 'From' addresses of the email.

methods.name: getTo
methods.description: Returns the 'To' recipient addresses.

methods.name: getCc
methods.description: Returns the 'Cc' recipient addresses.

methods.name: getBcc
methods.description: Returns the 'Bcc' recipient addresses.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Returns the email subject.

methods.name: getMessageId
methods.description: Returns the message ID.

methods.name: getSentDate
methods.description: Returns the sent date as a Timestamp.

methods.name: getReceivedDate
methods.description: Returns the received date as a Timestamp.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns the content type of the email.

methods.name: getMainPartCount
methods.description: Returns the number of main parts in the email.

methods.name: getSubPartCount
methods.description: Returns the number of sub-parts within a specified part index.

methods.name: getAttachmentIndexes
methods.description: Lists indexes of parts identified as attachments or inline parts.

methods.name: getMessageBody
methods.description: Extracts and returns the main message body as text.

methods.name: getMessageBodyContentType
methods.description: Determines the content type of the message body.

methods.name: getMessageRawText
methods.description: Returns the raw message text from the input stream.

methods.name: getPartDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of a specified part.

methods.name: getPartContentType
methods.description: Returns the content type of a specified part.

methods.name: getPartDisposition
methods.description: Returns the disposition (attachment/inline) of a specified part.

methods.name: getPartFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of a specified part.

methods.name: getPartByteBuffer
methods.description: Returns the byte buffer of a specified part.

methods.name: getPartText
methods.description: Returns the text content of a specified part.

methods.name: getPartRawText
methods.description: Returns the raw text from the input stream of a specified part.

methods.name: getPart
methods.description: Retrieves a BodyPart object based on a dot-separated index string.

methods.name: getContentText
methods.description: Converts content object to string text.

methods.name: getTextFromStream
methods.description: Reads text from an InputStream.

methods.name: getByteBufferFromStream
methods.description: Reads bytes from an InputStream into a ByteBuffer.
